description: Source code for the MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices protocol and its implementation LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices, providing screen recording and location services primarily for macOS.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: Concrete implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices providing screen recording and location services.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Records the screen with specified parameters asynchronously, returning the path to the saved recording and whether it includes audio.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current location accuracy authorization.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current CLLocation based on desired accuracy and optional timeout/configuration.
